policy_capture.review: Re-read the complete retained robots and copyright/disclaimer bodies and the current official public policy page. Exact policy hashes are checked again in the new capture before requesting the document. A changed or failed policy blocks acquisition.

policies.review: The exact /chips/samsung-electronics-texas-taylor path is not excluded by the wildcard-agent rules. Search paths, sitemap discovery, unrestricted crawling and issuer sites are not approved.

NIST identifies unmarked site information as public information that may be copied with appropriate credits, subject to copyrighted and product-specific exceptions. Raw HTML remains local; published output is operational metadata and original review analysis. Samsung-credited images, attached PDFs, linked releases and third-party material are not redistributed or independently acquired. No NIST endorsement or permission for Samsung's newsroom is inferred.

validity_note: One-day internal review window for this bounded manual handoff. Not a publisher-granted permission period or automatic renewal. Discovery disposition alone never authorizes a fetch; the separately bound acquisition plan and both live policy checks are required.
